title: Watering can
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body of watering can -->
  <rect x="25" y="45" width="45" height="40" rx="8" fill="#4FC3F7"/>
  <!-- lighter shade edge on body -->
  <rect x="25" y="45" width="12" height="40" rx="8" fill="#81D4FA"/>
  <!-- handle -->
  <path d="M30 45 Q30 20 50 20 Q68 20 68 40 L68 45" fill="none" stroke="#FFB74D" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- handle highlight -->
  <path d="M34 45 Q34 26 50 26 Q62 26 62 40" fill="none" stroke="#FFE082" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- spout base -->
  <rect x="65" y="55" width="18" height="12" rx="4" fill="#4FC3F7"/>
  <!-- spout -->
  <path d="M78 58 L95 40 L95 50 L82 65 Z" fill="#4FC3F7"/>
  <!-- spout top lighter edge -->
  <path d="M80 58 L95 40 L95 45 L82 61 Z" fill="#81D4FA"/>
  <!-- rose / sprinkler head -->
  <ellipse cx="93" cy="38" rx="6" ry="5" fill="#FF7043" transform="rotate(-45 93 38)"/>
  <!-- rose holes -->
  <circle cx="90" cy="36" r="1.2" fill="#FFCCBC"/>
  <circle cx="93" cy="35" r="1.2" fill="#FFCCBC"/>
  <circle cx="95" cy="38" r="1.2" fill="#FFCCBC"/>
  <circle cx="92" cy="39" r="1.2" fill="#FFCCBC"/>
  <circle cx="95" cy="41" r="1.2" fill="#FFCCBC"/>
  <!-- bottom rim -->
  <rect x="23" y="82" width="49" height="6" rx="3" fill="#29B6F6"/>
  <!-- water drops -->
  <ellipse cx="88" cy="52" rx="2" ry="4" fill="#B3E5FC"/>
  <ellipse cx="92" cy="57" rx="2" ry="4" fill="#B3E5FC"/>
  <ellipse cx="84" cy="58" rx="2" ry="4" fill="#B3E5FC"/>
  <!-- flower decoration on body -->
  <circle cx="47" cy="65" r="4" fill="#FFF176"/>
  <circle cx="41" cy="61" r="3" fill="#FFEE58"/>
  <circle cx="53" cy="61" r="3" fill="#FFEE58"/>
  <circle cx="41" cy="70" r="3" fill="#FFEE58"/>
  <circle cx="53" cy="70" r="3" fill="#FFEE58"/>
  <circle cx="47" cy="65" r="1.5" fill="#FF7043"/>
</svg>
